title: A Garden for the Crown
author: Theo Voss
blurb: Silas Ravensworth, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
